sentences.say: Why is good food wasted while families nearby miss meals?
sentences.note: tightened from 'Why is edible food thrown away while families nearby still miss meals?' (4.3 s) for timing

sentences.say: Often, timing, storage and transport break the link.
A shop's surplus crate is ready tonight.
But the kitchen has no cold space, and no van is free before it spoils.
Food-rescue groups can bridge it with timely pickups, safe storage and planned routes.
Before donating food, ask a verified local group what it accepts, and when.
sentences.note: 'organisation ... can accept' shortened to fit; meaning unchanged
